note: Two grouped rowless BF16 projections share a computed vector and retain their output epilogues. A unit matrix row lets both channels use the native MMA schedule while the leading column coordinate stays a group.

attrs.body:
for a0 in 0..4:
    for a1 in 0..16:
        for a2 in 0..256:
            in0 = load v[a0, a2, a1]
            in1 = load w[a0, a2, a1]
            in2 = load x[a2]
            bf16 v0 = -in2
            acc0 <- add(acc0, in1 * v0) over a2
            acc1 <- add(acc1, in0 * v0) over a2
        bf16 v1 = acc0
        bf16 v2 = acc1
        bf16 v3 = relu(v1)
        bf16 v4 = relu(v2)
        relu[a0, a1] = v3
        relu_1[a0, a1] = v4
